identity.name: Works — Unified System of Work Items
identity.description: Single source of truth for all work items (tasks, roadmaps, initiatives). Replaces separate tasks/ and roadmaps/.

meta.description: All work items live in honeycombs/works/. Each file represents a single work item. Horizon and scope are defined by fields, not by folder.
meta.purpose: Simplify Mandala core by unifying tasks and roadmaps into a single flexible structure.
principles: Horizon is defined by 'horizon' field (strategic/tactical), not by folder
Hierarchy is defined by 'parent_work' and 'sub_works' fields
No duplicate logic — one scanner, one index, one structure

field_definitions.name: Short, descriptive title
field_definitions.status: One of: planning, in_progress, active, done, archived, paused
field_definitions.priority: One of: critical, high, medium, low
field_definitions.sub_works: Array of child work_ids (empty if none)
field_definitions.depends_on: Array of work_ids this depends on

validation_rules: work_id must be unique across all works
If sub_works is not empty, horizon should be 'strategic'
If sub_works is empty, horizon can be 'tactical' or 'strategic'
parent_work must reference an existing work_id

structure.description: Flat structure: all work files in honeycombs/works/
structure.files: Each file is a single work item (JSON)
structure.index: This file (index.json) serves as the registry

health.notes: New unified work structure. Migration from tasks/ and roadmaps/ pending.
